map.木材含水率指所含水分占绝干质量的百分比；从纤维饱和点（约 30%）继续干燥到绝干: Wood moisture content is the percentage of water mass relative to oven-dry mass; once drying continues from the fiber saturation point (about 30%) toward oven-dry, the cell-cavity water is gone and the cell walls shrink, producing linear shrinkage (tangential about 6%–12%, radial about 3%–6%). This tool only does reading-magnitude conversion, not physical shrinkage calculation.
map.质检、工艺卡、供应商报告常用不同量级（百分比/小数/千分比），不统一直接相减会差: QC, process cards and supplier reports often use different magnitudes (percent / decimal / millipercent); subtracting directly without unifying differs by 100–1000×. Convert to one unit first, then compare, to avoid using 2.5% as 0.025 for stocking.

map.木材自纤维饱和点（约 30%）继续干燥到终了含水率时产生线性收缩；收缩系数随树种: Wood shrinks linearly when dried below the fiber saturation point (about 30%) to the final moisture content; the coefficient varies by species and direction (tangential about 0.26, radial about 0.15 %/1%MC). For process allowance estimation only.
map.线干缩率 = (初始含水率 − 终了含水率) × 收缩系数 k (%，线性近似): Linear shrinkage rate = (initial moisture content − final moisture content) × shrinkage coefficient k (%, linear approximation); once the original size is entered: shrunk size = original size × (1 − shrinkage rate÷100), absolute shrinkage = original size × shrinkage rate÷100, and the area of a square section after shrinkage ≈ original size² × (1 − shrinkage rate÷100)². Validation: invalid numbers are treated as 0, and the original size is an optional input. Criteria: reference values of k are 0.2–0.4 tangential, 0.1–0.2 radial, 0.01–0.02 longitudinal.
